articles.title_en: Similarity of Information and Collective Action
articles.title_cn: 信息的相似性和集体行动
articles.abstract_en: We study a canonical collective action game with incomplete information. Individuals attempt to coordinate to achieve a shared goal, while also facing a temptation to free-ride. More similar information can help them coordinate, but it can also exacerbate free-riding. Our main result shows that more similar information facilitates (impedes) achieving the common goal when it is sufficiently challenging (easy). We apply this insight to show why less powerful authoritarian governments may face larger protests if they restrict press freedom, when committee diversity is beneficial in costly voting, and when a more diverse community contributes more to public good provision.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个具有不完全信息的典型集体动作博弈。人们试图通过协调来实现共同的目标，同时也面临着搭便车的诱惑。更多类似的信息可以帮助他们协调，但也会加剧搭便车现象。我们的主要结果表明，当共同目标足够具有挑战性（容易）时，更多相似的信息有助于（阻碍）实现共同目标。我们运用这一见解来说明为什么权力较小的独裁政府如果限制新闻自由、委员会多元化有利于昂贵的投票、以及更加多元化的社区为公共利益提供更多贡献，那么它们可能会面临更大规模的抗议。

articles.title_en: A Long and a Short Leg Make for a Wobbly Equilibrium
articles.title_cn: 长腿和短腿形成不稳定的平衡
articles.abstract_en: We provide a model to explain how the interaction between the spot and lending markets for stocks can lead to abrupt changes in short selling activity. Furthermore, rational short sellers may choose to abandon the market even as mispricing widens. We document empirically that the dynamics of short selling are fat tailed and subject to abrupt changes, especially for the stocks that the model identifies as susceptible to such dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个模型来解释股票现货和借贷市场之间的相互作用如何导致卖空活动的突然变化。此外，即使错误定价扩大，理性的卖空者也可能选择放弃市场。我们根据经验证明，卖空的动态是肥尾的，并且容易发生突然变化，特别是对于模型识别为容易受到这种动态影响的股票。

articles.abstract_en: We embed diagnostic expectations in a workhorse neoclassical model with heterogeneous firms and risky debt. A realistic degree of overreaction estimated from US firms' earnings forecasts generates realistic credit cycles. Good times produce economic and financial fragility, predicting future disappointment of expectations, low bond returns, and investment declines. To generate the size of spread increases observed during 2007–2009, the model requires only moderate negative shocks. Diagnostic expectations offer a realistic, parsimonious way to produce financial reversals in business cycle models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将诊断预期嵌入到具有异构公司和风险债务的主力新古典模型中。根据美国公司盈利预测估计的现实程度的过度反应会产生现实的信贷周期。繁荣时期会产生经济和金融脆弱性，预示着未来的预期将落空、债券回报率低和投资下降。为了生成2007-2009期间观察到的利差增加的规模，该模型只需要适度的负面冲击。诊断预期提供了一种现实、简约的方式来在商业周期模型中产生金融逆转。

articles.abstract_en: We explore how traders' equity capitalization influences asset prices in a framework that accounts for market power. In our model, traders with capital constraints engage in transactions in an imperfectly competitive market. We demonstrate that looser capital constraints elevate both asset prices and price impact, the latter diminishing market liquidity. Using Canadian Treasury auction data, we illustrate how to apply our model to quantify these effects. We estimate the shadow costs of capital constraints by leveraging a temporary policy exemption during 2020–2021. We show that while these constraints are only infrequently binding, their relative impact when activated can be sizable.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在考虑市场力量的框架中探讨交易者的股权资本如何影响资产价格。在我们的模型中，资金受限的交易者在不完全竞争的市场中进行交易。我们证明，宽松的资本约束会提高资产价格和价格影响，后者会减少市场流动性。使用加拿大国债拍卖数据，我们说明了如何应用我们的模型来量化这些影响。我们通过利用2020-2021期间的临时政策豁免来估计资本约束的影子成本。我们表明，虽然这些约束很少具有约束力，但它们在激活时的相对影响可能相当大。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies which misspecified models are likely to persist when decision-makers compare them with competing models. The main result characterizes such models based on two features that can be derived from primitives: The model's asymptotic accuracy in predicting the equilibrium distribution of observed outcomes and the "tightness" of the prior around such equilibria. Misspecified models can be robust, persisting against any arbitrary competing model—including the true model—despite decision-makers observing an infinite amount of data. Moreover, simple misspecified models equipped with entrenched priors can be more robust than complex correctly specified models.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当决策者将其与竞争模型进行比较时，哪些错误指定的模型可能会持续存在。主要结果基于可以从原语导出的二特征来表征此类模型：模型在预测观察到的结果的均衡分布方面的渐近准确性以及围绕这种均衡的先验的“紧密性”。尽管决策者观察了无限量的数据，但错误指定的模型可能是稳健的，可以对抗任何任意的竞争模型（包括真实模型）。此外，配备了根深蒂固的先验的简单错误指定模型可能比复杂的正确指定模型更稳健。

articles.title_en: Negative Control Falsification Tests for Instrumental Variable Designs
articles.title_cn: 工具变量设计的阴性对照证伪检验
articles.abstract_en: The validity of instrumental variable (IV) designs is typically tested using two types of falsification tests. We characterize these tests as conditional independence tests between negative control variables—proxies for unobserved variables posing a threat to the identification—and the IV or the outcome. We describe the conditions variables must satisfy in order to serve as negative controls. We show these falsification tests examine not only independence and the exclusion restriction but also functional form assumptions. Our analysis reveals conventional applications of these tests may flag problems even in valid IV designs. We offer implementation guidance to address these issues.
articles.abstract_cn: 工具变量（IV）设计的有效性通常使用二类型的证伪测试来测试。我们将这些测试描述为负控制变量（对识别构成威胁的未观察变量的代理）与 IV 或结果之间的条件独立性测试。我们描述了变量必须满足的条件才能充当阴性对照。我们表明这些证伪测试不仅检查独立性和排除限制，还检查功能形式假设。我们的分析表明，即使在有效的 IV 设计中，这些测试的常规应用也可能会发现问题。我们提供实施指南来解决这些问题。

articles.abstract_en: We develop a simple multilayer network model in which agents allocate effort across layers with heterogeneous structures, subject to an aggregate effort constraint. Incentives are shaped by agents' network positions within each layer, and equilibrium behavior reflects both within- and cross-layer interactions. We analyze how shocks propagate through the network and characterize optimal targeting interventions. Our results show that effective policy design must account for effort allocation across layers. We also demonstrate that predictions from monolayer models can diverge sharply from those of multilayer models, underscoring the importance of accounting for network complexity in both empirical and policy analyses.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个简单的多层网络模型，其中代理在具有异构结构的层之间分配工作量，并受到聚合工作量约束。激励是由代理人在每一层内的网络位置决定的，平衡行为反映了层内和跨层的相互作用。我们分析冲击如何通过网络传播并描述最佳目标干预措施的特征。我们的结果表明，有效的政策设计必须考虑跨层的工作分配。我们还证明，单层模型的预测可能与多层模型的预测存在很大差异，这强调了在实证分析和政策分析中考虑网络复杂性的重要性。

articles.title_en: Spillovers in State Capacity Building: Evidence from the Digitization of Land Records in Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 国家能力建设的溢出效应：来自巴基斯坦土地记录数字化的证据
articles.abstract_en: Digitization reforms have been hailed as an effective way of strengthening state capacity. However, digitization can also fundamentally reshape the organization of bureaucracies. Using a unique administrative dataset on agricultural taxation and surveys of local bureaucrats from Punjab, Pakistan, we show that digitization reforms can have unintended consequences for state capacity. We exploit the staggered rollout of the digitization of land records in Punjab to show that digitization had a negative effect on tax collection. The fall in taxes was not due to a decrease in the tax base. Instead, digitization affected the bureaucrats' capacity to collect taxes.
articles.abstract_cn: 数字化改革被誉为增强国家能力的有效途径。然而，数字化也可以从根本上重塑官僚机构的组织。通过使用独特的农业税收管理数据集以及对巴基斯坦旁遮普邦当地官僚的调查，我们表明数字化改革可能会对国家能力产生意想不到的后果。我们利用旁遮普邦土地记录数字化的交错推出来表明数字化对税收产生了负面影响。税收下降并不是由于税基减少。相反，数字化影响了官僚的征税能力。

articles.title_en: Making Bricks from Straw: Resources and Productivity in Health Care
articles.title_cn: 秸秆变砖：医疗保健领域的资源和生产力
articles.abstract_en: Why do health facilities in developing countries do so poorly? This paper examines the role of financial constraints. I describe an experiment in which we surprised health workers in randomly selected public health clinics in Nigeria with a ₦600,000 grant paid out in installments over one year. Its administration was left entirely to health workers. The award led to large productivity gains. Using expenditure data combined with novel textual data, I provide an explanation for these effects. I show the award increased investments in physical and human capital, led to lower prices for patients, and inspired health workers to do better.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么发展中国家的医疗卫生设施如此落后？本文探讨了财务约束的作用。我描述了一项实验，在该实验中，我们在 一 年内分期支付了 ₦600,000 补助金，这让尼日利亚随机选择的公共卫生诊所的卫生工作者感到惊讶。其管理完全由卫生工作者负责。该奖项带来了生产力的大幅提高。我使用支出数据与新颖的文本数据相结合，对这些影响进行了解释。我展示了该奖项增加了对物质和人力资本的投资，降低了患者的价格，并激励卫生工作者做得更好。

articles.title_en: Abundance from Abroad: Migrant Income and Long-Run Economic Development
articles.title_cn: 来自国外的丰富：移民收入与长期经济发展
articles.abstract_en: We study how international migrant income prospects affect long-run development in origin areas. We leverage the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis exchange rate shocks in a shift-share identification strategy across Philippine provinces. Initial migrant income shocks are magnified six-fold over time, increasing domestic income, education levels, migrant skills, and high-skilled migration. Remarkably, 74.9 percent of long-run income gains come from domestic rather than migrant income. Trade driven impacts of exchange rate shocks are orthogonal to effects via migrant income. A structural model reveals that 19.7 percent of long-run income gains stem from educational investments. International migration fosters broad economic development in origin communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究国际移民收入前景如何影响原籍地区的长期发展。我们利用1997亚洲金融危机的汇率冲击在菲律宾各省实施转移份额识别策略。随着时间的推移，最初的移民收入冲击会放大六倍，增加国内收入、教育水平、移民技能和高技能移民。值得注意的是，74.9%的长期收入增长来自国内收入而不是移民收入。汇率冲击对贸易的影响与移民收入的影响是正交的。结构模型显示，19.7% 的长期收入收益来自教育投资。国际移民促进了原籍社区的广泛经济发展。
